title: Vertices plausible under two decoding hypotheses
rationale: On a 1240 x 1220 mm panel the vertex stream fits the identity and the swap axis maps (Hausdorff 20 mm, INFO;27 within 20 mm of either edge): two hypotheses pass, and exactly one must, never tie-broken (safety-model 12, step 3). The design's case list asks for two encodings; under the documented encodings (x;y and length;angle) no realistic panel decodes to its rectangle both ways, so the case uses two axis maps.
